hotel.name: Verdura Resort, Rocco Forte Private Villas

verified_facts.text: Verdura Resort offers three- and four-bedroom villas overlooking the Mediterranean Sea and the Sicilian countryside.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elegant 3 and 4 bedroom villas overlook the Mediterranean Sea and Sicilian countryside.

verified_facts.text: The three-bedroom Agata villas have views of the Verdura golf course, the white-sand shoreline and the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Soak up sweeping views of the Verdura Golf course, white-sand shoreline and the sparkling seascape from our three-bedroom Agata Villas.

verified_facts.text: The Smeraldo villas are sea-front three-bedroom villas with front-row views of the resort's shoreline.
verified_facts.excerpt: our sea-front Smeraldo three-bedroom villas enjoy front-row views of Verdura Resort

verified_facts.text: The Topazio four-bedroom villas are spread across two floors.
verified_facts.excerpt: our Topazio four-bedroom villas are spread across two floors

verified_facts.text: The Topazio villas overlook a large private pool in a leafy garden, with the sea on the horizon.
verified_facts.excerpt: a large private pool in a leafy garden with the sparkling seascape on the horizon

verified_facts.text: The Corallo villas are sea-front four-bedroom villas over two floors with uninterrupted views of the southern Sicilian sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: our sea-front Corallo four-bedroom villas are spread across two floors and enjoy uninterrupted views of the southern Sicilian seascape.

verified_facts.text: Verdura Resort is on Sicily's southern coast.
verified_facts.excerpt: unspoilt southern coast, Verdura Resort is a rare expression of privacy and place

verified_facts.text: The resort has two championship golf courses and a nine-hole par-3 course, designed by Kyle Phillips as a links experience by the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two championship courses and a nine-hole par-3, designed by Kyle Phillips, create a true links experience by the sea.

verified_facts.text: The links-style golf courses span 230 hectares of Sicilian coastline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our links-style courses span 230 hectares of Sicilian coastline

verified_facts.text: The restaurants and bars are connected to the resort's own farm, with menus by Fulvio Pierangelini ranging from Italian classics to Japanese cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: connect to the land via the resort's own farm. Menus by Fulvio Pierangelini travel from Italian classics to Japanese cuisine.

verified_facts.text: Nagori, Fulvio Pierangelini's most intimate restaurant, is inside the ancient Saracen Tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fulvio Pierangelini's most intimate restaurant is found within the ancient Saracen Tower.

verified_facts.text: Nagori applies Japanese techniques to Mediterranean produce through seasonal menus.
verified_facts.excerpt: Japanese techniques elevate Mediterranean produce through seasonal menus that create a dialogue between two islands.

verified_facts.text: Amare serves fresh seafood on the beachfront.
verified_facts.excerpt: settle in for a night of sublimely fresh seafood on the beachfront

verified_facts.text: Zagara's seasonal ingredients are handpicked from the resort's organic garden, including Verdura olive oil.
verified_facts.excerpt: Seasonal ingredients are handpicked from our organic garden, including our fragrant Verdura olive oil.

verified_facts.text: Zagara is open for dinner from March to November.
verified_facts.excerpt: Zagara is open for dinner from March to November.

verified_facts.text: Nagori is open for dinner from June to October.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nagori is open for dinner from June to October.

verified_facts.text: Liola is open for lunch and/or dinner from March to November.
verified_facts.excerpt: is open for lunch and/or dinner from March to November. Availability may vary throughout the season.

verified_facts.text: The flagship spa uses homegrown botanicals and draws on longevity wisdom from the blue zone of nearby Caltabellotta.
verified_facts.excerpt: the flagship spa through homegrown botanicals and the longevity wisdom from the blue zone of nearby Caltabellotta

verified_facts.text: Scirocco Bar's hand-painted walls are the creative vision of Paolo Moschino and Philip Vergeylen, painted by artist Phyllis Clair Smith.
verified_facts.excerpt: The creative vision of Paolo Moschino and Philip Vergeylen, given form by artist Phyllis Clair Smith.

verified_facts.text: L'Osteria is an all-day, sea-facing restaurant using farm-grown produce and the day's catch from Sciacca.
verified_facts.excerpt: All-day and sea-facing, L'Osteria is where farm-grown produce and the day's catch from Sciacca inspire Italian favourites and daily specials
